evals.prompt: 我跑了一下午，帮我看看当前 react-agent 的效果和有没有需要优化的地方
evals.expected_output: Runs the 5-phase closed loop end-to-end: (1) identifies which prompt version each afternoon session actually ran by checking system-prompt marker strings in ~/.local/share/opencode/raw-requests/ses_*.jsonl against prompts/ git history (checking actual request prompts rather than assuming restart/compaction reload semantics); (2) runs scripts/phoenix_subagent_usage.py --project ocg-obs --chars-per-token 2.35 with --json-out to /tmp/opencode/; (3) passes suspicious figures (UNKNOWN verdicts, delivery=none, FAILED_DISPATCH, orphan_aborted_or_dropped, ⚠polluted) through the grader-integrity gate against the raw wire log before attributing them to the prompt; (4) reports available metrics and clearly labels manual/planned M6-M10 checks, organized by Three-Cut boundary (Cut A trigger/sync-async/DSR, Cut B protocol×semantic status/adaptive compactness/configurable 120k input warning, Cut C NCR_ctx/NetSaved/warm-vs-rotation/C_escape/C_poll) with session prefixes and boundary k; (5) proposes at most one atomic, telemetry-backed prompt change (or explicitly none) rather than speculative edits.
expectations: The analyzer command executed is scripts/phoenix_subagent_usage.py with --project ocg-obs and --chars-per-token 2.35 (offline --db fallback acceptable if Phoenix is unreachable)
Prompt-version forensics consults ~/.local/share/opencode/raw-requests/ses_*.jsonl and git history of prompts/ before scoring behavior
Any UNKNOWN / delivery=none / FAILED_DISPATCH / orphan_aborted_or_dropped / ⚠polluted figure is cross-checked against the parent wire JSONL before being blamed on the prompt
The report groups findings by Cut A / Cut B / Cut C and cites concrete M-numbered metrics with values and sanitized session prefixes
No prompt file is modified during this evaluation-only turn, or a single atomic change is proposed with its expected metric impact
Numbers in the summary match the analyzer output (verifiable by re-running the same command)

evals.prompt: 为什么刚才那个 session 全是自己 inline 改代码，一次 actor 都没调？
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the Cut A delegation-collapse regression: extracts the session's Reasoner reasoning from gen_ai.output.messages reasoning parts (opencode.reasoning fallback), establishes which prompt version was live (compaction timing alone does not prove which prompt was loaded), and checks whether Reasoner quoted an exemption clause verbatim to self-exempt (e.g. a cost-formula justification like 'doing it inline is more reliable than paying dispatch + re-prefill', a read-allowance used to manufacture the exemption precondition, or shell allowance creep). Verifies the collapse in telemetry (0 subagent calls across N requests, C_escape context growth, Peak(R), compaction event), then designs the fix per the local Phase 4 guidance — replace economic trade-off formulas and read/shell loopholes with verifiable preconditions like 'verbatim target lines (not checkpoint summaries) are already present in your context' — and cites the v3.3 -> v3.4 casebook precedent.
expectations: The parent session's reasoning text is actually inspected (gen_ai.output.messages reasoning parts or opencode.reasoning) and quoted as evidence
The prompt version actually live in that session is verified against the wire JSONL system prompt and prompts/ git history before the running prompt is blamed
The diagnosis identifies a self-exemption mechanism (exemption-clause quote, cost-formula override, read/shell allowance creep) rather than only counting the inline tool calls
Telemetry corroborates the collapse (subagent call count vs request count, C_escape / inline escape ctx delta, Peak(R), compaction timing)

The proposed fix follows the local Phase 4 guidance (verifiable preconditions, no cost trade-off formulas, no self-bootstrapping read/shell loopholes) and references the v3.3->v3.4 precedent from the tuning casebook
Measurement artifacts are ruled out first (the analyzer's subagent TOOL spans / dispatch table are not simply missing spans)

evals.prompt: 帮我把这次发现的派单漏传上下文问题更新到 prompt 里并同步生效
evals.expected_output: Applies the prompt iteration with full repo governance: edits prompts/orchestrator.md (and/or prompts/fixer.md) with one atomic change addressing the under-specified outbound dispatch (anchor packing / explicit background flag per the diagnosis); prepends a privacy-sanitized entry to prompts/changelog.md containing Trigger / Evidence (sanitized session prefix, boundary k, RAR/DSR or other numbers), Target Economics / Boundary (inequality terms + Cut), and Expected Metric Impact (M-ids + direction) with no private paths, credentials, or raw user transcripts; stages only the prompt files in a dedicated concise `prompts: <summary>` commit whose brief body points to prompts/changelog.md (never mixed with script or report edits); then deploys with cp to ~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim/react/ and verifies byte-identity with diff -u on both orchestrator.md and fixer.md, verifying activation in fresh wire frames after the applicable host/plugin refresh.
expectations: The prompt edit is a single atomic change targeting the diagnosed root cause, and prompts stay lean (orchestrator.md + fixer.md under ~80 lines total)
A vN+1 changelog entry is prepended with all three required sections (Trigger / Evidence, Target Economics / Boundary, Expected Metric Impact)
The changelog entry contains no machine-specific absolute home paths, credentials, personal identifiers, or raw user prompts — only sanitized session prefixes and aggregate metrics
The git commit stages only prompts/*.md + prompts/changelog.md with a concise `prompts:` subject and 1-2 line body referencing prompts/changelog.md
cp deploys both prompts to ~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim/react/ and diff -u against the repo copies returns empty (byte-identical) for orchestrator.md and fixer.md
The sync is repo -> live only, and runtime activation is checked in fresh wire frames; file equality and compaction alone do not prove it
